note: Chapter 1 is keyed from 'headed clear' (the header) through 'drops' (the bounce) and 'first time' (the half-volley) to 'goal' (the ball in the net): keep the pauses at '...' so that stretch plays near real time. Chapter 2 is the slow-motion replay; 'strikes' is the contact.

chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Cardiff, 2006, the FA Cup final. Liverpool are losing three-two in added time, and Steven Gerrard waits, thirty-five yards out. The ball is headed clear... it drops... first time... goal! Three-three!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Tired legs, but head down, body leaning over the ball, and he strikes right through the middle.

chapters.label: Bottom corner
chapters.text: Low and hard, past keeper Shaka Hislop, into the bottom corner! Liverpool win the cup on penalties.

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: body over the ball, strike through the middle, and your long shot stays low and powerful.
